page_title: LEV 3-2 RBL | Bayer Leverkusen v RB Leipzig 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Felix Brych is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The substitution is prepared. Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Victor Boniface.
89' Substitution. Jonas Hofmann walks off the pitch and Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
86' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
84' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Xaver Schlager will be replaced by Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig).
81' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
78' Jeremie Frimpong will be replaced by Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
75' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) replacing Lois Openda.
75' Substitution. Florian Wirtz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
74' OFF THE POST! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.

71' 3 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Simakan peels away from his marker to connect with the resulting free kick and heads the ball towards Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who does brilliantly to nod the ball into the net. He makes it 3:2.
70' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
69' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Felix Brych and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

64' 3 - 1 Jeremie Frimpong passes the ball into the penalty area. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 3:1!
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes onto the pitch for Timo Werner.
62' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Xavi Simons and he is replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
62' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolas Seiwald.
62' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) is booked.
61' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
57' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' A lofted cross from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
53' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Felix Brych blows his whistle as Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
50' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. RB Leipzig force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Great chance! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45+2' The shots on goal statistics – 4:3.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
39' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
39' David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
37' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

35' 2 - 0 Jonas Hofmann takes over corner duties and expertly finds Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the right side of the goal. The score is now 2:0.
34' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will deliver the corner kick.
33' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
31' Felix Brych blows for a foul after Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
28' The game is interrupted. Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
28' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

24' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Boniface shows great vision to find Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
23' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
19' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
15' The referee blows his whistle as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in his challenge.
13' Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Brych no option but to blow his whistle.

12' That didn't go as planned! Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Lukas Hradecky, who easily kept it out.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
8' Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
7' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Felix Brych blows for a foul.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen).
2' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Janis Blaswich thwarts him with a nice save.
